svg.title: Cache benchmark comparison: attempts 1 and 2
Cache benchmarks: first run versus rerun
svg.desc: Grouped bars compare save time, restore time and SDK upload speed for ten payload sizes from 20 MiB to 4 GiB. Bars are three-run medians; whiskers show minimum and maximum. At 4 GiB, save is 22 versus 18 seconds, restore 41 versus 29 seconds, and upload speed 408.3 versus 582.2 MiB/s. Exact values for all sizes are in the adjacent report tables.
